review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: D4, G3, G4, control, masks, and automated report were independently inspected.
review_views.notes: Both main fields are visible; the intended six-part hierarchy is not.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The complete G4 image was inspected at native size.
review_views.notes: NE-west, SE-west, and SE-east are not independently recognizable.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Both relief fields and four foothill footprints were enlarged and inspected.
review_views.notes: Pixel differences exist in the weak foothills but do not create recognizable landforms.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: All nine regions and the four edge gates were inspected.
review_views.notes: External pixels remain exact; defects are internal repetition and missing hierarchy.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: Six footprints were compared to the final and report statistics.
review_views.notes: NE-central is marginally visible; the other three foothills fail recognition.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.evidence: D4 and G4 were compared at matching extent and reduced scale.
review_views.notes: Color continues, while repeated bright centers create an avoidable raised appearance.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: Road-adjacent and external boundaries were reviewed.
review_views.notes: The 16px guard removes the broad G3 seam and all three roads remain continuous.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Canonical road, settlement, coast, forest, and field detail was checked.

review_views.label: Leafletデスクトップ表示
review_views.evidence: Native and enlarged desktop-scale views were assessed without staging G4.

review_views.label: Leafletモバイル表示
review_views.evidence: Reduced overview was assessed without staging G4.
review_views.notes: Only the two main fields remain reliably visible.

immediate_failures.label: 海岸線・河川・主要道路・城壁の移動

immediate_failures.evidence: Three foothills are not recognizable, and NE-central reads only as a small radial symbol.

immediate_failures.evidence: No noncanonical major feature was introduced.

immediate_failures.label: AI生成文字・記号

immediate_failures.label: 目視できる継ぎ目

immediate_failures.label: 現代物・透かし・署名

scores.label: 正典・地形形状との一致

scores.label: 親子ズームの連続性

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: Bright radial centers remain incompatible with irregular flat hachure.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: The narrow protection policy keeps roads and details clear.

summary: G4 is independently rejected. It validates the narrow protected-composite strategy and eliminates broad road voids, but three foothills remain unreadable and repeated radial bright-centered terrain marks fail the Golden gate.
required_changes: Retain the G4 narrow protection strategy without modification.
Change only terrain mark generation so every footprint has a distinct compact non-convergent form without bright centers or repeated rosettes.
